_meta.title: Public sequencing datasets with documented Torque teno virus / anellovirus detection
_meta.generated_by: Claude — v1.0 compiled from web-sourced primary literature. v1.1 (2026-06-24): PubMed/SRA verification pass resolved accessions for devlaminck2013_cell (SRP032345, open), asct_mngs_2018 (PRJNA504035, open), confirmed young2015_ajt SRA deposit (PRJNA unresolved), filled citation fields for 6 entries, flagged tisza2024_anellome_preprint as duplicate of modha2025_ve, confirmed chinamap2022_blood_virome is HGRAC-controlled with no SRA deposit.
_meta.scope: Human-focused datasets (RNA-seq, WGS, DNA shotgun metagenomics, virion/VLP-enriched metagenomics, and cell-free DNA) in which detection of Torque teno virus (TTV) and/or other human anelloviruses (TTMV, TTMDV) is reported in the source publication, with emphasis on whether raw data is publicly retrievable.
_meta.biology_note: TTV/anelloviruses are small circular ssDNA viruses (family Anelloviridae): Alphatorquevirus = TTV (~3.6-3.9 kb), Betatorquevirus = TTMV (~2.8-2.9 kb), Gammatorquevirus = TTMDV. Because the genome is DNA, detection is most robust in DNA assays (WGS / shotgun / VLP metagenomics). TTV is transcriptionally active, so transcripts also appear in total RNA-seq, but yields are typically lower and openly downloadable TTV-positive RNA-seq is scarcer.
key_caveats: MODALITY: DNA-based datasets give the strongest, most direct TTV signal. RNA-seq detection is real but lower-yield and is dominated here by one resource (GTEx meta-transcriptome) whose raw data is access-controlled.

ASSEMBLY: Short reads frequently fail to close anellovirus circles because of a GC-rich stem-loop near the replication origin (Tisza et al. 2020). Expect fragmented contigs; ORF1 is the most recoverable region and the standard unit for classification.

CONTAMINATION: Reagent and per-flow-cell carryover can generate false anellovirus/virus positives (documented in Moustafa et al. 2017). Use reagent-only negative controls and per-flow-cell sanity checks before trusting low-abundance calls.

ACCESS: Several large, high-prevalence cohorts (Moustafa/Human Longevity Inc, ChinaMAP) and the GTEx RNA-seq raw data are NOT openly downloadable. They prove detection but require either authorized access or are commercially unavailable.

VERIFICATION: Every accession carries a 'verification' flag. Entries flagged 'accession_unconfirmed' or 'citation_partial' MUST be checked against the article's Data Availability statement before an agent attempts download or cites them. Do not invent accessions.

verification_legend.accession_confirmed: The specific accession(s) were seen verbatim in a primary/official source during compilation.
verification_legend.accession_unconfirmed: The study clearly performed relevant sequencing and is likely deposited, but the exact accession was not retrieved; must be verified.
verification_legend.citation_partial: Core finding (TTV detected) and a stable identifier (PMID/PMCID/DOI) are confirmed, but some bibliographic fields (authors/journal/DOI) were not verified in this pass.

access_legend.open: Raw data publicly downloadable from SRA/ENA/Zenodo/GenBank with no application.
access_legend.controlled: Raw data exists but requires an access application (e.g., dbGaP Authorized Access, ChinaMAP governance).
access_legend.commercial_unavailable: Data generated by a commercial entity with no public deposit located.
access_legend.derived_open: Not raw reads but openly available derived products (assembled genomes, sequence DB, tables) that point back to public raw data.
access_legend.needs_verification: Public availability is plausible but was not confirmed; check the article.

how_to_use_this_file: 1. To get DOWNLOADABLE positive-control data: filter datasets where access == 'open' and modality includes a DNA method. The single highest-yield positive control is dataset id 'wang_oral_srr2037085'; the richest multi-sample set is 'arze2021_chm'.
2. To enumerate runs from a BioProject: query ENA (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/) or NCBI SRA for the PRJNA accession in accessions.bioproject, then retrieve each run.
3. To download an SRA run: use sra-toolkit ('prefetch <SRR>' then 'fasterq-dump <SRR>') OR fetch FASTQ directly from ENA ('https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/<SRR>').
4. For access == 'controlled': do NOT attempt direct download. Surface the access route in download_route to the user (e.g., dbGaP phs accession) and stop.

5. For verification == 'accession_unconfirmed' or access == 'needs_verification': resolve the PMID/PMCID/DOI, open the Data Availability statement, extract the real accession, THEN proceed. Never fabricate an accession.
6. For TTV read-mapping/classification: use a reference DB from reference_resources (SCANellome or CHVD) rather than RefSeq alone, because anellovirus diversity is vastly under-represented in RefSeq.
7. Respect the contamination caveat: require negative/reagent controls or per-flow-cell checks before reporting low-abundance anellovirus hits as real.

download_recipes.dbgap_controlled: Requires dbGaP Authorized Access application for the listed phs accession; not directly downloadable.
download_recipes.zenodo: Resolve the Zenodo DOI and download the record archive.
download_recipes.genbank_tpa_range: Use NCBI efetch over the accession range (e.g., db=nuccore) to retrieve assembled sequences.

detection_notes.taxonomy: Family Anelloviridae. Human genera of interest: Alphatorquevirus (TTV), Betatorquevirus (TTMV), Gammatorquevirus (TTMDV); plus under-sampled human genera (e.g., Hetorquevirus, Memtorquevirus, Samektorquevirus).
detection_notes.why_dna_first: Circular ssDNA genome → strongest signal in DNA assays. RNA-seq captures transcripts (TTV is transcriptionally active; mRNA confirmed by RT-PCR in multiple cell lines) but at lower yield.
detection_notes.assembly_pitfall: GC-rich stem-loop at the replication origin breaks short-read assembly of the full circle; expect truncated contigs near that region.
detection_notes.contamination_control: Anellovirus/virus false positives can arise from reagent and per-flow-cell carryover; include reagent-only controls and check for flow-cell co-localization of positives.
